turns.display_text:
Bangor International (BGR) ranks highest among New England airports with a score of 68.6, followed by Boston Logan (BOS, 59.8) and Portland International Jetport (PWM, 55.9). BGR and BOS are robust to weight variations, while PWM is sensitive to the weighting.

| Airport | Size Tier | Passenger Score | Flight Score | Capacity-Need Score | Recommendation | Robustness |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bangor (BGR) | Nonhub | 75.4 (BGR) | 61.7 (BGR) | 68.6 (BGR) | Prioritize for due diligence (BGR) | Robust (BGR) |
| Boston Logan (BOS) | Large | 53.1 (BOS) | 66.5 (BOS) | 59.8 (BOS) | Investigate further (BOS) | Robust (BOS) |
| Portland Jetport (PWM) | Small | 73.7 (PWM) | 38.0 (PWM) | 55.9 (PWM) | Investigate further (PWM) | Sensitive (PWM) |
| Burlington (BTV) | Nonhub | 55.3 (BTV) | 46.9 (BTV) | 51.1 (BTV) | Investigate further (BTV) | Sensitive (BTV) |
| Providence (PVD) | Small | 40.5 (PVD) | 47.2 (PVD) | 43.8 (PVD) | Deprioritize (PVD) | Rarely in top (PVD) |
| Bradley (BDL) | Medium | 48.6 (BDL) | 36.4 (BDL) | 42.5 (BDL) | Deprioritize (BDL) | Rarely in top (BDL) |
| Manchester (MHT) | Nonhub | 10.1 (MHT) | 13.8 (MHT) | 11.9 (MHT) | Deprioritize (MHT) | Rarely in top (MHT) |

- Data reflects the 2025-08..2026-07 window against the 2019 baseline.
- Capacity-need scores (0–100) weight passenger growth (25%), load factor (25%), flight growth (25%), and congestion (25%). Scores serve as a proxy for filled capacity, not financial ROI.
- BGR shows strengths in passenger growth (89.9 percentile) and flight growth (74.9 percentile). BOS shows strengths in congestion (98.9 percentile) and load factor (82.1 percentile).
- Robustness measures how frequently an airport stays in the top 3 across 500 randomized weighting scenarios (BGR and BOS: 99%; PWM: 80%).
- Warning: Tweed New Haven (HVN) received a partial score of 81.4 because no delay data is reported; congestion is unknown (not zero), so it cannot be compared directly with full scores.

This is a data screen, not investment advice: confirm with site studies, airline demand and financial analysis before committing capital.

turns.question: Thanks. Going back to SNA, what was its delay rate?
turns.display_text:
John Wayne Orange County Airport (SNA) had an arrival delay rate of 18.3% for flights arriving 15 or more minutes late.

| Metric | SNA |
|---|---|
| Arrival delay rate (15+ min) | 18.3% (SNA) |

- Delay figures cover domestic arriving flights of BTS-reporting airlines during the 12-month period 2025-08..2026-07.
